sentence: This project studies how a changing climate affects harmful algal bloom toxins and how these toxins affect the brain.
This project builds a robot made of many segments joined by hinged joints that can bend into many shapes using only two motors.
This project studies how atoms and molecules move in liquids and glasses and how bending and stretching membranes changes their magnetic patterns.
This project studies how individual bacteria swimming in dense suspensions give rise to the collective flow of the whole group.
This project builds tools that automatically generate features from existing features to describe entities and predict outcomes better.
This project builds a portable device that collects and concentrates viruses from field samples by size, without using antibodies.
This project studies how microbes are gained and passed on among wild reptiles on an island, and how they relate to disease.
This project studies the unusual superconductivity of uranium ditelluride crystals in very strong magnetic fields.
This project builds hands-on kits and digital tools for teaching soft robotics and studies how well they work.
This project builds a computer vision framework that learns how objects and scenes in the physical world are put together from simpler parts.
This project builds a cybersecurity program covering secure software, secure systems, security analytics and security management.
This project studies how swimming behavior in young fishes shapes the bones of their fins as adults.
This project studies how different strains of a bacterium called Agrobacterium differ in their ability to insert genes into poplar plants.
This project studies how quantum correlations can be used to build machine learning models that need less cost and complexity.
This project builds tools and practices to protect the computer systems and data of ships that carry out ocean research.
This project builds software that helps scientists run computing programs on cloud services without managing servers themselves.
